name: Section-isolated supply diagram
aliases: switchgear Switchboard source and bus interfaces
summary: Shows the intentionally disconnected supply paths of the selected bus section for diagram interpretation.
description: Shows the intentionally disconnected supply paths of the selected bus section for diagram interpretation. A source and bus arrangement shows how incoming supplies and outgoing circuits can be connected. Breaker and tie positions determine which sections are energized and whether sources can become electrically paralleled.

In a switchgear lineup with two incomers and a bus tie, the single-line arrangement helps the engineer identify normal supply paths and which loads change source during a transfer. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Defined isolation boundaries” at the input and “Isolated-section representation” at the output. An illustration cannot establish actual field isolation.

Keep normal positions, transfer limits, source independence and protection-zone boundaries visible.
